summary: SMOKE test (frontend-only, per explicit user request) passed. Homepage, Shop, Product Detail, and Admin Login all load successfully with images rendering and no 4xx/5xx network errors.

Admin login flow (password gate at /admin -> /admin/dashboard) works end-to-end with celestaglow2024.
